title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P06: Operation Don't Look: leave / the bush
summary: Sam's 3-step plan. He pretends to leave. He disguises himself as a bush.

lines.text: Operation Don't Look. Step one: we pretend to *leave*.
lines.tts: [briefing, serious] Operation Don't Look. Step one: we pretend to leave.
lines.note: MS: Sam beside a cardboard sign with stick drawings (pointer stick).

lines.text: Step two: we hide. Step three: we catch it growing!
lines.tts: [building excitement] Step two: we hide. Step three: we catch it growing!

lines.text: Four is not a real step.
lines.tts: [dismissive] Four is not a real step.

lines.text: Well! Bye, tree! Going *far* away! Very far!
lines.tts: [loud, overacting] Well! Bye, tree! Going far away! Very far!
lines.note: WS: he marches off frame left, loudly. Silence. The sprout starts to stretch... Sam's head pops back in from the frame edge.
The sprout is frozen mid-stretch, innocent.

lines.text: You were gone for two seconds.
lines.tts: [deadpan, clearly] You were gone for two seconds.

lines.text: Good afternoon. I am... not Sam. Just a guy. Looking at trees.
lines.tts: [fake deep voice, very formal] Good afternoon. I am... not Sam. Just a guy. Looking at trees.
lines.note: He strolls back in wearing fake nose-glasses with a big mustache, hands behind his back, whistling.
Pulls the glasses off; the mustache stays stuck for a beat, then drops.
The gap: a BUSH shuffles slowly across the yard toward the sprout (Sam's legs + red scarf end visible). It freezes whenever Layla glances. Pip lands on top.
He argues with Pip; behind him the sprout grows a third leaf. Layla notices, keeps knitting.

beats: l9 gap: Sam strolls back in disguised (nose-glasses + mustache), hands behind his back, whistling.
l12 gap: THE BUSH — it shuffles across the yard toward the sprout (Sam's legs + scarf end visible) to sneaky music; it freezes whenever Layla glances (x3); Pip lands on top.
